newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FAA, USAir settle alleged violations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FAA, USAir settle alleged violations.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration said Friday USAir agreed to settle 84 civil penalty cases stemming from alleged violations of operations, maintenance and security regulations from 1990 to 1996.
Under the consent order and agreement signed today, USAir will pay $450,000 in full settlement, an FAA statement said.

The FAA agreed not to prosecute any civil penalty actions or claims arising from the cases. Signing of the order does not constitute and admission of wrongdoing by USAir, it said, adding the cases did not indicate a systemic problem that would call into question the safety of USAir operations.
